title: Upload and review
intro: Add a document, let Spark read it, then confirm what it was not sure of. A person confirms every field Spark was not sure of before the review is finished.

denied.title: Uploading documents is for Support
denied.description: Your role cannot upload documents. Sign in as Support to try it, or open an order to see its documents.
denied.demoDescription: Your role cannot upload documents. Switch to Support to try it, or open an order to see its documents.
denied.failed: Could not switch. Try the Demo role menu in the top bar.

preview: Demo: a file you add stays in your browser and is not stored. Spark reads synthetic sample documents only, and no AI model is connected.

drop.title: Drop documents here
drop.limits: PDF, PNG, JPEG, XLSX or CSV. Up to {{size}} MB each, up to {{count}} files.

files.label: Files to read
files.notRead: Not read: only the first sample is read

refused.type: {{name}} is not a PDF, PNG, JPEG, XLSX or CSV file.
refused.disguised: {{name}} says it is {{claimed}} file but its content is not. It was not added.
refused.tooMany: Only {{count}} files at a time. {{name}} was not added.
refused.unreadable: {{name}} could not be read in your browser.
refused.duplicate: {{name}} is already in the list. It was not added twice.

startNeeds: Add a file or use the demo purchase order first.

steps.classify: Decided it is a customer PO
steps.fields: Read {{count}} fields and how sure it is of each

review.title: Review what Spark read
review.summary: {{count}} fields read: {{sure}} above {{threshold}} percent, {{unsure}} for you to approve.
review.mock: Confidence is what Mock AI reports for this synthetic document.
review.ring: Fields to approve that you have confirmed
review.pageImage: Page {{page}} of purchase order {{number}}, with a box on each field Spark read
review.finishedBody: Nothing was saved and no order was made. This sample belongs to order {{order}} in the sample data.
review.failed: The demo document could not be loaded.
review.failedHelp: Check your connection, then try again.
review.left_one: {{count}} field left to approve before you can finish
review.left_other: {{count}} fields left to approve before you can finish
review.leftNone: Nothing left to approve. You can finish the review.

editHelp.text: Change the value as it should read, then save. Saving confirms it.
editHelp.quantity: A whole or decimal number above zero, such as 1,200 or 2.5. Saving confirms it.
editHelp.price: An amount of money as a number, such as 61.20. Saving confirms it.
editHelp.date: A real date, such as 11 Nov 2026. Saving confirms it.

editError.blank: This field cannot be blank. It keeps its old value.
editError.quantity: Enter a whole or decimal number above zero. It keeps its old value.
editError.price: Enter an amount of money as a number, such as 61.20. It keeps its old value.
editError.date: Enter a real date, such as 11 Nov 2026. It keeps its old value.

leave.title: Leave this review?
leave.body: Your review is not saved. If you leave, what you confirmed or corrected here is lost.

add.title: Add documents
add.intro: Each file is checked in your browser: its type, its size and what is really inside it.

saves: Nothing is saved and no order is made in this preview.
